name: noise-background
blurb: Animated gradient layers moving with spring physics over noise texture.
description: Motion-based background with multiple coloured gradient layers that move organically within the container. Layered with noise texture and optional backdrop blur.
use_when: A sophisticated, animated container background with moving gradients and fine noise texture.
avoid_when: Accessibility-sensitive contexts — continuous animation with no prefers-reduced-motion guard.
a11y: Wrapper component with content slot (z-10). Animation has no prefers-reduced-motion guard.
